user.title: Connect EVBox Gen4 charging station
user.description: The charging station must be reachable through an active Home Assistant Bluetooth proxy.

abort.already_configured: This charging station is already configured
abort.not_supported: The discovered device is not a supported EVBox Gen4 charging station

wifi_connect.title: Select Wi-Fi
wifi_connect.description: The scan is performed by the charging station, not by Home Assistant.

wifi_clear.title: Remove Wi-Fi connection
wifi_clear.description: The Wi-Fi configuration stored in the charging station will be deleted.

rfid_clear.title: Remove all charging cards
rfid_clear.description: The local charging-card list in the station will be emptied.

backend.title: Charging backend
backend.description: Matches the server and online settings in the app's installer mode.

satellite_scan_results.title: Discovered charge points
satellite_scan_results.description: The selected charge point is stored in addition to existing paired charge points.

satellite_pair.title: Pair charge point by serial number

satellite_unpair.title: Unpair charge point
satellite_unpair.description: Other paired charge points are preserved.

firmware.title: Update firmware
firmware.description: Home Assistant downloads HTTPS and HTTP files and temporarily serves them to the charger over FTP. Only use firmware verified for the exact model.

error.cannot_connect: The charging station could not perform the request
error.wifi_scan_failed: The Wi-Fi scan failed. Manual entry can still be used.
error.wifi_connection_failed: The charging station could not connect to Wi-Fi
error.wrong_wifi_password: The charging station reports an incorrect Wi-Fi password
error.no_wifi_networks: The charging station found no Wi-Fi networks
error.no_rfid_cards: No charging cards are stored in the charging station
error.no_satellites_found: The charging station found no additional charge points
error.no_paired_satellites: No additional charge points are paired
error.max_satellites: At most ten charge points can be paired
error.password_required: A password is required for this secured Wi-Fi network
error.rfid_card_exists: This charging card is already stored in the charger.
error.invalid_rfid_id: The card ID may contain only 1 to 20 letters and digits.
